files_changed.summary: Updated to properly support extracting subdomains on localhost without failing.
Added subdomain routing group with Spatie NeedsTenant middleware and preview route.
Created controller for rendering the published storefront and draft preview.
Created Blade view to dynamically render SellerPage blocks and theme.

architecture_impact: Established the storefront subdomain architecture. Subdomain requests are routed to SellerStorefrontController and scoped via Spatie's Tenant model.
qa_focus_areas: Verify the live preview iframe inside the Seller Panel renders without 404.
Verify visiting a seller's subdomain renders their published page.
